title: When Solvers Get Moody: Quantifying and Predicting Performance Variability in Mixed Integer Programming
abstract: arXiv:2610.12876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixed-integer programming (MIP) solvers are widely used, yet their performance can vary substantially even under seemingly neutral perturbations. Such variability complicates benchmarking, and the interpretation of computational studies. We introduce the Weighted Variability Score (WVS), a robust multi-component metric that aggregates dispersion in normalized runtime, final optimality gap, LP iterations, and branch-and-bound nodes across repeated runs. On a large subset of MIPLIB 2017 instances, each solved in 100 randomized runs under a four-hour limit, WVS reveals a right-skewed distribution with a substantial upper tail: many instances are essentially stable, but some exhibit large variability that is not explained by basic properties alone. translated_title: 当求解器变得喜怒无常：量化与预测混合整数规划中的性能变异性
translated_abstract: 混合整数规划（MIP）求解器被广泛使用，但即使在看似中性的扰动下，其性能也可能出现显著波动。这种变异性给基准测试和计算研究结果的解读带来了困难。我们提出了加权变异性分数（WVS），这是一个稳健的多组件指标，它综合了重复运行中归一化运行时间、最终最优性间隙、LP迭代次数以及分支定界节点数的离散程度。在MIPLIB 2017实例的一个大型子集上（每个实例在四小时时限内进行100次随机化运行求解），WVS揭示出一种具有显著上尾的右偏分布：许多实例基本保持稳定，但部分实例表现出无法仅用基本属性解释的大幅变异性。值得注意的是，该实验在两次SCIP运行中成功证明了长期开放实例'neos-5045105-creuse'的最优性。利用静态描述符和根节点级特征，基于树的预测器结合门控尾部（机制），（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出加权变异性分数（WVS）来量化MIP求解器在重复运行中的性能波动，并利用静态特征和根节点级特征构建预测器来预测这种变异性，同时首次证明了开放实例neos-5045105-creuse的最优性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Weighted Variability Score (WVS) to quantify performance variability in MIP solvers across repeated randomized runs, and develops a tree-based predictor using static and root-level features to forecast such variability, while also proving optimality of the open instance neos-5045105-creuse.
